Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Kanpur is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or equivalent degree, or have 3 years of research, teaching, and design and development experience after ME/M.Tech with at least one SCI journal publication.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: You can apply by sending your complete application along with required documents via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 58,000 per month, plus HRA as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Research Associate-I.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 208016.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
